lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's twenty-four? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 24? Nope!

lines.text: A B equals A C, and B D equals B C. Angle A B D is twenty-four degrees.
lines.caption: AB equals AC, and BD equals BC. Angle ABD is 24°.

lines.text: What is angle A, at the top?
lines.caption: What is angle A, at the top?

lines.text: Call the top angle a. The outside angle at D is a plus twenty-four.
lines.caption: Call the top angle a. The outside angle at D is a plus 24.

lines.text: B D equals B C, so angle C is a plus twenty-four too.
lines.caption: BD equals BC, so angle C is a plus 24 too.

lines.text: And angle A B C matches angle C.
lines.caption: And angle ABC matches angle C.

lines.text: The big triangle: three a plus forty-eight is one hundred eighty.
lines.caption: The big triangle: 3a plus 48 is 180.

lines.text: Three a is one hundred thirty-two, so a is forty-four!
lines.caption: 3a is 132, so a is 44!

lines.text: Did you get forty-four? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 44? Tell me below!
